contract.entry: 0x4150abee, only after a normal return from the unresolved indirect call at 0x4150abeb
contract.index: Actual EDI bit pattern at entry, tested signed >64 before EAX equality. No lower bound is present. W5 parser index7+1 is 1..128 only if intervening code/providers preserve the established argument/register identity.
branches: Signed index >64 or EAX == EDI goes to original return 0x4150b55c without selected frame stores.
guard_offset_word == 0 bypasses the first TLS compare and guard-word read.
Nonzero guard_offset_word is stored at frame+1c before signed comparison global[4250775c] > TLS+8. Taken edge to 0x4150b77c is not implemented.
When the first epoch compare is not greater, DWORD[[4250770c]+guard_offset_word] !=0 returns. Zero proceeds to 0x4150ac40.
frame+128 is written ffffffff before the unresolved direct call 0x41b6c670. Observed EAX is then stored to frame+1c even when zero; zero returns.
Signed global[4250065c] > TLS+8 selects unimplemented 0x4150b831 before loading [424fdd9c].
A zero [424fdd9c] selects the unresolved local path 0x4150ac88; no table base is invented.
A nonzero [424fdd9c] branches to 0x4150afa7, adds frame+1c modulo 2^32, and tests BYTE[index_word+sum]. Zero returns, any nonzero reaches 0x4150afb4.

provider_observations.dispatch_return_eax: EAX returned at 4150ABEB, not reconstructed target/effects; optional absence is not zero.
provider_observations.guard_offset_word: DWORD at address loaded from [4223FE60], only if the prior index/dispatch gates pass.
provider_observations.guard_epoch: DWORD [4250775C] and DWORD TLS+8 at 4150AC0D..4150AC28. TLS is [FS:2C + 4*[42518540]].
provider_observations.guard_word: DWORD[[4250770C]+guard_offset_word] at 4150AC36, only after nonzero offset and non-greater epoch.
provider_observations.source_return_eax: EAX at 4150AC4F after normal return of 41B6C670; opaque word, not a typed object or host pointer.
provider_observations.slot_epoch: DWORD [4250065C] and the separately read DWORD TLS+8 at 4150AC5A..4150AC75; must be post-call observations.
provider_observations.slot_base_word: DWORD [424FDD9C] at 4150AC7B, only after nonzero source return and non-greater epoch.
provider_observations.slot_byte: Byte actually observed at returned slot_address; caller is responsible for the address/observation identity.

preconditions: This is a conditional suffix, not a solution to W6 FS:0/FS:30 guard, register jump, out-of-image object or dispatch provider.
Inputs are observations at their individual read points, not a claim that one immutable runtime snapshot supplies all reads.
Normal provider returns and the observed register/frame continuity are required; unobserved provider side effects, exceptions and concurrent writes are outside this local transform.
Supplied guard_word and slot_byte correspond to the original 32-bit effective addresses and readable memory; the offline code never dereferences those addresses.
State contains only two selected direct frame writes. Initial state is supplied and is retained on earlier stops; no original stack initialization is inferred.
Result edges diagnose local control flow. next_epoch_gate is not message acceptance, a PositionRecord write, or proof of whole-path reachability.
No new floating-point operations. Integer observations retain exact 32-bit patterns and signed CMP/JG comparisons without host signed overflow.
Existing C++17 is the offline reconstruction language, not evidence of original source language/standard or complete ABI.
